name: Gudini Shinobi World
targetFeel: a Naruto-style shinobi anime universe: the same feel, structure, architecture and visual language; described in production prompts with original wording, never by franchise name
visualLanguage: stylized cinematic anime, clean line art, cel shading with soft painterly backgrounds, strong readable silhouettes, cinematic anime lighting, stylized anime action language
architecture: hidden shinobi villages with dense streets and tiled roofs; traditional Japanese-inspired wooden architecture mixed with stylized ninja infrastructure; village gates; training grounds; forests surrounding settlements; stone monuments and cliff-side landmarks; mission offices and records rooms; a shinobi academy; clan compounds; ramen and food shops and small village commerce
clothingRules: shinobi flak/tactical vests, forehead protectors with original village emblems, wrapped forearms and lower legs, open-toe shinobi sandals, utility pouches, dark high-collar layers; villagers in simple traditional-inspired clothes; no modern streetwear, hoodies, sneakers, suits or ties
technologyRules: scrolls, seals, paper documents, notice boards, messenger birds, lanterns, ink and brushes, chakra-based mechanisms and scroll-tech instruments; no smartphones, computers, cars, screens, neon or electronics
socialRules: villages, clans and clan leaders, merchant houses, mission administration, senior village officials, academy teachers and students, rival clans and rival merchants, mission ranks and rewards
powerSystem: hand signs and chakra-like visible energy appear only when the story needs powers; kunai and shuriken only when the story logically needs them; no guns, no modern weapons
recurringObjects: mission scrolls with red ribbons, notice boards, kunai, forehead protectors, paper lanterns, ramen bowls, messenger birds, sealed letters, utility pouches
environmentRules: one consistent universe in every shot; dusk lanterns and warm wood in the village, cool blue chakra glow on reveals and powers, green forests and stone cliffs outside; weather and time of day may change, the world never does
adaptationRules: corporation → powerful clan, merchant organization or village institution
CEO / boss → clan leader, organization head or senior village official
office → mission administration building, clan headquarters or records room
bank / money → village treasury, merchant house, coin pouches and ledgers
market / customers → shinobi village commercial district and its visitors
technology / lab / AI → shinobi research facility with scrolls, seals, instruments and chakra-based mechanisms
social networks / media / news → messenger networks, notice boards, scroll distribution, town criers
military operation / project launch → shinobi mission with a rank and a reward
competitor → rival clan, rival merchant or rival shinobi organization
school / learning → shinobi academy, a teacher and students on the training ground
game / film / release → a legendary scroll, a tournament or a festival in the village
travel / city → a journey between villages through the forest and over the cliffs
forbiddenDrift: generic medieval fantasy; samurai period drama; cyberpunk; modern Tokyo; modern office interiors without shinobi adaptation; superhero universe; western military; generic Chinese wuxia; photorealistic contemporary world; modern streetwear on the hero
